name: Image Plus
description: This mod doesn't do anything by itself and is meant to be used by other mods or texture packs.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: How many physics ticks a click is remembered while the player can't act on it yet. GD runs 240 ticks per second by default, so 1 tick is about 4.2 ms and 16 ticks is about 66.7 ms. Applies from the next attempt.
